svg.title: Our wilderness creatures — step 4: Give your creature a personality
svg.desc: Arrange a little already-loose moss or grass for hair, layer leaf clothes, and add suitable stone features. You can draw a face on your own card instead. Keep everything loose and try different expressions. A simple friend is just as good as a detailed one.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Add hair, clothes and a face
